title: CouncilMessage

evidence.description: Checkable citation: file:line-range, path, command output, or `quoted excerpt`. Empty or uncheckable evidence causes the runner to force support_level to 'unsupported'.

confidence.description: 0 to 1; the runner rejects values outside that range.

deciding_evidence.description: What concrete evidence would settle this finding if disputed. Use null when not applicable.

reason.description: accept: what evidence changed your mind. partial: which components are accepted vs rejected, and why. reject: why the claim fails.

evidence.description: Checkable counter-evidence. The runner REQUIRES this (non-null) when rejecting an opponent's finding. Null otherwise if none.

contest_support_level.description: Contest the opponent's self-assigned support_level, or null.

proposed_fix.description: Concrete fix proposal for accepted findings (proposal only; Review mode never applies changes), or null.

deciding_evidence.description: When maintaining a dispute: the concrete evidence that would settle it. Null otherwise.
